formal_role: Measures finite output change over finite input interval
systems_modeling_role: Useful for observed data intervals and coarse-scale model summaries
review_warning: May conceal local thresholds shocks or nonlinear behavior inside the interval

formal_role: Defined as the limit of average rates as interval length approaches zero
systems_modeling_role: Supports local sensitivity velocity marginal analysis and dynamic interpretation
review_warning: Requires differentiability at the operating point

formal_role: Scales derivative by output or by input-output ratio
systems_modeling_role: Supports proportional sensitivity and dimensionless comparison
review_warning: Can be unstable near zero values or outside positive domains

formal_role: Defines system motion as a derivative of state with respect to time
systems_modeling_role: Supports differential equation modeling simulation and local stability analysis
review_warning: Requires invariant-domain checks and careful numerical discretization

systems_modeling_role: Supports computation when symbolic derivatives are unavailable
review_warning: Requires step-size convergence and roundoff review
